guatape.title: Guatapé
guatape.description: Experience the vibrant colors of Guatapé and climb the monolithic El Peñol rock for breathtaking panoramic views of the reservoir. A premium, private journey tailored to your pace.
includes: Private boat ride on the lake
guatape.fee_note: No hidden fees. Pay directly on the day of the tour.

medellin.title: Medellín
medellin.description: Discover the incredible transformation of Medellín. Visit key city landmarks and immerse yourself in the vibrant street art and history of the Comuna 13 escalators.
medellin.fee_note: No hidden fees. Pay directly on tour day.

cafe.title: Coffee Farm Experience
cafe.description: Head into the mountains of Antioquia and discover the artisanal process of Colombian coffee, from seed to cup, at an authentic traditional coffee farm.
cafe.fee_note: No hidden fees. Pay directly on tour day.

aeropuerto.title: VIP Airport Transfer (MDE)
aeropuerto.description: Start or end your journey with maximum comfort. Private transfer service in premium vehicles to or from the José María Córdova International Airport.
aeropuerto.fee_note: Price per vehicle, not per person.

about.title: Not just an agency. We are your private concierge.
about.description: We design tailor-made experiences for discerning travelers. Forget rigid itineraries and large crowds; at MR, you set the pace. We connect you with the true essence of Medellín through premium vehicles, expert local guides, and flawless service.

reviews.name: Sarah Jenkins
reviews.text: An incredible experience in Guatapé. The service was flawless from hotel pick-up to drop-off. Our guide knew every hidden spot.

reviews.name: Michael T.
reviews.text: I don't usually leave reviews, but the level of detail from MR Medellín is next level. The SUV was immaculate and the coffee farm was very exclusive.

reviews.name: David & Emma
reviews.text: We booked the airport transfer and ended up booking all our tours with them. Luxury, punctuality, and warmth.
